steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/ as admin/admin, chose "Skip" on the "Update your password" prompt, then used Ctrl+K search and opened the provisioned "Service Health" dashboard (/d/bench-service-health/service-health). The dashboard shows exactly three panels; their titles, read from the live DOM headings (h2) in layout order, are: "Request rate", "Error count", "Latency by endpoint".
